title: Who Owns the AI Budget? The CFO's New Capital Mandate
subtitle: On 9 September 2026, Deloitte and Salesforce published separate CFO surveys showing finance now owns AI capital allocation. A mid-cap industrial CFO must decide how much autonomy agents get before the board's Q2 review.
category: AI Governance, Capital Allocation & CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 10 September 2026. Publicly reported facts from Deloitte Finance Trends 2027 (released 9 September 2026; 1,434 respondents): 54% of finance leaders lead cross-enterprise AI and technology capital allocation; 48% oversee AI trust and reliable outputs; 48% control AI and technology spending; 95% comfortable with agentic workflows in at least some finance activities, but only 14% support full autonomy for critical decisions; 55% require human oversight to deploy AI agents in finance; 43% prioritize AI and advanced technology through FY2027; 36% see primary AI return as productivity, 23% as revenue enablement. Salesforce CFO Priorities Report (9 September 2026; 865 finance leaders): nearly three-quarters say the role expanded this year, with managing AI the biggest reason; 65% manage multiple revenue models; 71% sell through more channels than a year ago; 90% of AI users report ROI; top blockers include security (46%) and governance/integration (42%). Composite firm: Deccan Industrial Systems Ltd. Composite decision-maker: CFO Arjun Menon.
